title: Kagamine Len — The Twin Servant〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lucifenian Palace - Dungeon
(It really becomes pitch black at night.)
(Tomorrow at three is when it happens...)
(Why did all this happen...?)
(If only I'd been there by Riliane's side, as her brother, things wouldn't have come to this...)
(Her not remembering isn't her fault. We became pawns in a game of political chess...)
(I would ultimately go from being Prince Alexiel to Allen, the adopted son of Leonhart, one of the Three Heroes...)
(Back then, we were too little to do anything about it...)
(And if there's anything that I'd like to go back and redo, it would be that time...)
Riliane's Room

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Allen, take this...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: A small bottle with a piece of parchment inside...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Take it out and read it.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Yes, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (She wants me to do what to Leonhart...?)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (To my own father...?)

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Surprised? I suppose anyone would be.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (I understand how she and Father aren't getting along but...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I would not stand a chance against the likes of Leonhart, one of the famed Three Heroes...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Fear not, for I have a plan.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: He has a soft spot for drinks, does he not? If we use that to our advantage...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (If I told her that he's the man who raised me, would she be willing to reconsider...?)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (No, if I do, she might remove me from my current role and send me off somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (I still remember how innocent she used to be. I'll never forget the time she showed me the back way out of the palace…)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Even if she doesn't remember, I'm still Riliane's...)

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: This plan is also to be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Little Riliane
rows.Line: This is our little secret, okay?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Yes, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Um, if I may ask... Why the bottle?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: I was taught long ago to place the relay messages and wishes of the highest priority in this manner...

rows.Speaker: Little Allen
rows.Line: You're supposed to write it on a piece of paper like this, put it in a bottle and send it out to sea.

rows.Speaker: Little Allen
rows.Line: Then, your wish will come true.

rows.Speaker: Little Allen
rows.Line: Is there anything you want to wish for, Riliane?

rows.Speaker: Little Riliane
rows.Line: Umm... I want to be reborn as a horse!

rows.Speaker: Little Riliane
rows.Line: The palace is so boring. I'd rather be a horse that can travel and have fun!

rows.Speaker: Little Riliane
rows.Line: What are you gonna wish for, Alexiel?

rows.Speaker: Little Allen
rows.Line: Me? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Allen...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Do not let me down.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Yes, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (She shouldn't be able to remember anything from back then...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (It's been twisted and warped, but it's still there...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (A fragment from when we were still twins...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (And she wants me to do this to Father... How did this happen...?)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(Ugh... My head's a mess...
I can't tell if I'm happy or sad.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine how I look right now... Am I smiling...? Or am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Father. I...)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lucifenian Palace - Dungeon

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (I ended up placing Riliane's wish over my own...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (He was a hero of this land... The man who raised me... Using such a dirty trick with my own hands...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (If only I gave a different response that time...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (But there's nothing I can do to change things now. There's no turning back...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (If things went even the slightest bit differently, she may have been spared from her grisly fate...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (My first love...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I have a long night ahead of me...
